newsitem.title: ITALY: Mediaset sees progress made in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Mediaset sees progress made in 1996.

text.p: Italian media group Mediaset said it expected a general improvement in its operations during 1996, but declined to comment on reports of its pre-tax profits published in the Milan newspaper Milan Finanza.
After a board meeting, Mediaset confirmed only the positive progress in advertising sales in 1996, with a rise at its Publitalia division of about 6.7 percent from a year earlier.
The company also said it expects an improvement of around three points in its operating margins on its consolidated sales.
In 1995, the group's gross operating margin was around 52.9 percent while operating profits were 24.8 percent of consolidated sales.
